ash: Need a short internal blurb for tomorrow's patch release (v2.15.2). Ops wants copyable text + rollback path.

leah: Keep to 4 lines: what, impact, action, rollback. Ops likes exact deploy commands.

mike: Draft:
leah: • What: tweak batching heuristic to reduce tiny-batch overhead (tag: v2.15.2).
• Impact: expected ~6% p90 improvement for low-throughput traffic; no schema or analytics changes.
• Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.15.2 --canary 5 (30m) -> 25 (45m) -> prod. Pin: v2.15.2.
• Rollback: disable feature flag batching.new_heuristic and deploy tag v2.15.1 if errors >0.5% or p95 +20% for 30m.

sre-oncall: Oncall: @sre-oncall. I'll watch errors and CPU. Abort if thresholds hit.

comms: Add emoji mapping so ops channel looks neat (:zap: perf, :wrench: action, :rotating_light: rollback).

deploy-bot: Queued deploy job id=1733337777: env=staging tag=v2.15.2 canary=5%. Use `/deploy status 1733337777`.

ash: Final copy for #deploys (pasteable):
"""
:zap: What: batching heuristic tweak (v2.15.2).
:zap: Impact: ~6% p90 improvement for low-throughput requests; no schema changes.
:wrench: Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.15.2 --canary 5 (30m) -> 25 (45m) -> prod. Pin: v2.15.2.
:rotating_light: Rollback: if errors +0.5% absolute OR p95 latency +20% sustained for 30m -> disable flag batching.new_heuristic + deploy v2.15.1.
"""

leah: I'll post at T-20 and pin. Mike — paste dashboards after this.
